standard: DET-FEE-AND-WAIVER-001 with amendments A1, A2, A3 and A4

FILING_DESTINATION.basis: the committed route obligation census records this route's destination, and the committed worklist records it a second time

statement.name: Clerk of the sentencing superior court
statement.detail: File the motion and proposed order in the sentencing superior court, serve the prosecutor, and expect a possible hearing. The certificate of discharge under RCW 9.94A.637 is normally obtained first.

alsoRecordedInWorklist: court Clerk of the sentencing superior court File the motion and proposed order in the sentencing superior court, serve the prosecutor, and expect a possible hearing. The certificate of discharge under RCW 9.94A.637 is normally obtained first
FILING_DESTINATION.corroboratedBy: CR 08.0930: If you want to have a record of felony conviction vacated, you must file a motion with the court in which you were convicted.
FILING_DESTINATION.whyNotAnAuthority: A1 as read by its own amendment: naming an authority is what honesty requires when the record is empty; it is not a way to avoid stating what the record contains.

whatWasSearched.countsAsHeldUnder: DET-FEE-AND-WAIVER-001-A2 (the compiled state profile, named as a requiredSourceId by the route obligation census for these routes)
whatWasSearched.found: Three fee statements, all Washington State Patrol criminal-history record fees: WATCH online name/DOB check $11; mail conviction CHRI request $32; fingerprint-card CHRI request $58; notarized letter additional $15; non-conviction CHRI copy fingerprint card plus $12; in-person non-conviction record review no fee.
whatWasSearched.why: Those are the fees WSP charges to give a person their own criminal-history record. The obligation here is the fee a court charges to file a petition or motion to vacate. Under A3 holding is per fact: a record that prices a different transaction does not price this one.

whatWasSearched.found: "Court filing-fee practices for vacation petitions (CrRLJ/CR forms) and juvenile sealing motions vary by county and court — confirm the current filing fee or fee-waiver process with the clerk (source gap — no fixed court filing-fee amount stated in the Nationwide source)."
whatWasSearched.why: The state pack records the gap rather than closing it, and names the same authority this packet names. It corroborates that nothing is held; it establishes no amount.

whatWasSearched.found: filingFee and feeWaiverTreatment both carry status not_recorded on every route on this host.
whatWasSearched.why: A recorded non-establishment is not an answer. Publishing it as one would invert A1.

namedCheckableAuthority.name: Clerk of the sentencing superior court
namedCheckableAuthority.howToReachIt: the clerk's office of the court identified under FILING_DESTINATION, which is the court named in the caption of your judgment and on the docket for the case
answersWhichQuestions: whether a filing fee applies to this petition or motion in that court
whether a fee waiver is available and how to apply for it
namedCheckableAuthority.theSameOfficeTheOfficialInstructionsDire: To schedule a hearing, contact the clerk of the court where you were sentenced and ask for the date and time for the hearing.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.refusalToInvent: No amount is stated because no held record states one. A named office the participant can actually reach is the complete deliverable here; a plausible figure would not be.

recipient.basis: the committed worklist records this route's service recipients
statement: Serve the prosecutor for the sentencing superior court and expect a possible hearing
Serve the prosecutor's office for the sentencing court and file proof of service
recipient.corroboratedBy: CR 08.0930: On the same day that you file those documents with the clerk of the court, you must also provide a copy of the motion and notice documents to the prosecuting attorney’s office that prosecuted you.

methodAndTiming.basis: CR 08.0930, the official Washington instruction sheet for this route's form series, rehashed against the committed corpus index at build time
methodAndTiming.statement: On the same day that you file those documents with the clerk of the court, you must also provide a copy of the motion and notice documents to the prosecuting attorney’s office that prosecuted you.
methodAndTiming.copies: Once you have completed and signed the motion and declaration form, make at least two copies.
methodAndTiming.note: The worklist does not record the method or the timing. The route's own official instruction sheet does, so under A1 the packet states it rather than naming an authority to ask.

howToReachTheRecipient.statement: You can find the address and phone number of the Prosecutor’s Office here: https://waprosecutors.org/prosecutordirectory/
howToReachTheRecipient.a3Note: Named only for the form series whose own instruction sheet prints it; it is not carried across to the other series.

SELF_HELP_STOP.basis: the committed track registry's exact selfHelpStopConditions for this route
statement: Any pending charge in Washington, another state, federal court, or tribal court.
Any domestic violence element, charged or findable from the court file.
Any protection, no-contact, antiharassment or civil restraining order currently in effect, or violated in the last five years.
Any DUI, physical control, or alcohol or drug related driving offence, including a reduced charge.
Any firearm, deadly weapon or sexual motivation enhancement.
Any question about offence class or the exact RCW.
Any participant whose real goal is firearm rights restoration, which is a separate proceeding under RCW 9.41.041.
No certificate of discharge has been entered.
The felony class or the exact RCW cannot be established from the judgment and sentence.
The offence may be a crime against persons under RCW 43.43.830 even if it is not a violent offence under RCW 9.94A.030.
Assault in the third degree where the victim may have been a law enforcement or peace officer.

grantsNothing: Stating an obligation is not legal approval, does not promote this family and opens no commercial route.
